script: Voyager 1 is the most distant object ever made by humans. It launched in 1977 and is still sending messages home. In 2012 it became the first spacecraft to reach interstellar space. It carries a golden record with sounds and greetings from Earth. Its signals now take almost a full day to reach us. Follow WonderBytes for more facts that sound fake but are true.
